description: Read-only compact comparison of official LAMal premiums from the OFSP data, without contact details. Use the exact birth year and ask for every material choice. Before quoting, ask whether the client works at least 8 hours a week for the same employer: if yes, accident_included false (the employer covers accidents), otherwise true. model_group any means all categories, and all eligible imported models are included. The result carries comparison_id, submission.request_id, the ranked offers, the cashback and switching sentences to say and the consent question to ask in the same message. Client texts come in the requested language (texts all for four). Keep the technical fields yourself; the client fills no website form. The ranking uses the official premiums. One person per call; for a household use compare_lamal_household.

inputSchema.description: Criteria for one person. For a household (2-12 people, one insurer for all) use prepareHouseholdQuote.

accident_included.description: Explicit JSON boolean required (not the string "true"). Ask before quoting whether the client works at least 8 hours a week for the same employer: yes means false (the employer covers accidents), otherwise true. Never infer it.

birth_year.description: Exact four-digit birth year, not an age.

deductible_chf.description: Annual deductible: adults (19 or older in 2027) 300, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000 or 2500; children (18 or under) 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500 or 600. No interpolation.

language.description: Language of the client texts, model names and HTML pages; a region suffix is ignored.

model_group.description: any = all categories; BASE = free choice of doctor; PRAXIS = family doctor / HMO network; FLEX = hybrid model; TEL_DIG = telemedicine first; PHARM = pharmacy first.

municipality.description: Official municipality name; required with ambiguous region/model availability unless municipality_bfs is given.

premium_year.description: Tariff year: always 2027, the only imported year (metadata.supported_years). Required, no default.

texts.description: Client texts (cashback, switching, consent messages) in the requested language only (default) or in fr, de, it and en (all). Quote only; not part of the comparison.

name: compare_lamal_premiums

accident_question.description: Ask before quoting: employees working at least 8 hours a week for the same employer usually exclude accident cover (accident_included false).

adviser_url.description: Page where the client submits alone; null when the form is disabled.

cashback.description: Premium reduction Swiss Premium Insurance grants to each insured person, only for requests made through an AI assistant, once a contract concluded through SPI is approved by the insurer. Premiums and ranking shown are the official ones, without the reduction.

changes_premium.description: The official premium used for the ranking is not altered; the client benefit is the reduction in benefit_form.

client_sentence.description: Say as provided in the client language. Quote: requested language only (texts=all for fr, de, it, en); full premiums route: four languages. null when disabled.

insured_persons.description: Household results only: number of insured persons.

basis.description: one_month_premium per insured person and contract; amount set by SPI after review.

rationale.description: Same languages as client_sentence; null when disabled.

data.description: Origin and freshness of the official data; manifest_url lists source files and the last official sync.

eligible_models.description: Every eligible model as a table, same engine and filters as offers; complete coverage, not limited to broker agreements.

full_response_url.description: Full response for independent verification; no token or contact data.

model_groups.description: First-contact rule per model_group code present in offers.

offers.description: Top 10 by net premium, same ranking as assurs.ch.

model_name.description: Model name in the requested language (display translation of the official name).

model_name_official.description: Official French model name from the OFSP file.

premium_monthly_chf.description: Net official monthly premium in CHF; quote this value.

profile.description: Criteria as applied plus resolved municipality, canton and region.

request_url.description: Short readable form link built from the criteria (/adviser?premium_year=…&postal_code=…); append &agent=<your name>, optionally &insurer_id=. No contact data. null when the form is disabled.

results_url.description: HTML results page to share with the client; no token.

submission.description: How to send the client-approved request. Keep comparisonToken private; never put it in a link.

client_messages.description: Quote and household: requested language only (texts=all for fr, de, it, en); full premiums route: four languages.

channel_labels.description: Localised {channel} values for email, phone and email_or_phone.

consent_confirmation.description: Fill {request_id} and {channel}; it says the request cancels nothing, the 30 November deadline and the free SPI help. The receipt also returns it filled (client_confirmation).

consent_request.description: Ask this once, in the same message as the offers, filling {insurer}, {model} and {premium} (household: {insurer}, {persons}, {premium} total); a reply giving an email or phone is the consent.

comparison.description: Legacy criteria; copy unchanged with comparisonToken when comparison_id is unavailable.

comparison_id_valid_until.description: comparison_id lifetime (30 days); results_url and adviser_url follow it. Prefer comparison_id over the token.

enabled.description: false: sending is disabled; offer adviser_url instead.

request_id.description: Fresh per response; copy it as request_id of the submission.

request_template.description: submitOfferRequest body to fill; contact.email and contact.phone are empty strings: fill the ones you have.

switching.description: Switching deadline and free SPI help (cancellation, premium subsidies). Say client_sentence with the offers; a request to SPI cancels nothing by itself.

client_sentence.description: Deadline, free cancellation help and free subsidy help; requested language only unless texts=all.

deadline.description: Date by which the cancellation must REACH the current insurer.

subsidy_sentence.description: Say it when the client mentions a modest income or asks about premium subsidies.

texts_language.description: Language of the client texts in this response.

title: Compare official LAMal premiums
